messages:
Maria: Quick heads-up — ran the quarterly entitlement scan last night. Results: ~42 roles with no owner, 7 service accounts with project-wide KMS decrypt, and 3 keys that have overly broad IAM bindings.
Chris: ugh. can you paste the CSV or the query output?
Maria: short snippet pasted below for context:
```
role,owner,bindings
project-admin,,group:devops@redwood.com
svc-infer-worker,svc-deploy-bot,roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
analytics-reader,,roles/viewer
```
Devin: do we have a mapping key-id -> app owner? if not we should remove decrypt from svc accts until owners confirm.
Irene: +1. Recommend a temporary deny/condition on the keys and an owner-verification ticket. Also tag keys with data-classification=prod for extra review.
audit-bot: entitlement-scan (automated) completed. Summary: 42 ownerless roles, 7 KMS svcacct decrypt bindings. Report: /incidents/ENT-2026-042
Chris: proposed plan (quick):
- Create owner-verification tickets for ownerless roles (assign to infra-rotation), due in 7 days.
- Revoke broad KMS decrypt perms for the 7 svc accts, replace with narrow templates.
- Add IAM condition on high-value keys requiring request.auth.claim_sub in approved list (temporary guardrail).
- Owners can request restoration via the ticket workflow after justification.
Maria: I can draft the ticket template and prepare the CSV of affected roles.
Devin: I’ll take the KMS deny and rollout with eng-infra. Need a short runbook entry; will open a PR for the deny policy.
Irene: please add an automated owner-reminder that fires at day 3 and day 7 after ticket creation. If no owner by day 10, escalate to security ops.
Chris: let's also add two observability items: count(ownerless_roles) metric and a weekly digest that posts summary to #eng-security.
Maria: created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/1721 — added checklist + CSV export of affected roles.
Devin: filing rollout PR for the IAM condition and revoke script, will link in the GH issue.
Irene: schedule a 30m triage to go over top 10 keys/roles next week?
Chris: calendar invite sent for Mon 10am PT. Agenda: confirm owners for top 10, approve KMS deny test, sign off on ticket templates. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/rbac-cleanup
Maria: tagging @Sam from product to confirm owners for analytics roles flagged in the scan.
Sam: I’ll take analytics-owner confirmations this week and update the issue.
Maria: thanks — after the sync I’ll update the GH issue and move items to the remediation board.
Chris: quick note — for the service accounts we should also rotate keys once perms are tightened. Add rotation to the checklist.
Devin: noted. I'll add rotation step and a small script to re-encrypt any cached secrets.
Irene: small security ask: include a short blurb in the ticket to require a justification snippet (why this service needs decrypt) and expected token lifetime.
Maria: will include justification template.
Chris: tl;dr — agreed plan, owners assigned, sync booked, remediation GH issue exists. If nobody objects we start the revokes next Tue during a staged window. :thumbsup:
Sam: sounds good.
Maria: closing loop here — will post updates after the Monday sync. Thanks everyone!
